name: hologram
//peer: Whichever app is Jarvis brings its own copy of these; both of them already depend on all eight directly. Skia is only a type import in the main entry, but the react entry calls into it, and the conversation entry calls into the ElevenLabs SDK and, for the recorded greeting, LiveKit's audio session and hologram's own native player (expo) on a device, expo-audio in a browser. The native player is why this package has an expo-module.config.json: both apps autolink it.
//exports: Three entries, and the split matters: '.' is the design, the voice tracking and the ElevenLabs credentials, with nothing but type imports in it, so it runs headless in the tests and under CanvasKit in a browser. './react' is the view, which needs React, Reanimated and Skia for real. './conversation' needs React and the ElevenLabs SDK but deliberately not Skia, so a screen can hold a conversation before CanvasKit has loaded. './react/sample' is sample mode's clock-made voice, mood toast and frame-rate readout, Skia-free like './react/lifecycle' so a browser screen can import it before CanvasKit has loaded. './react/hologram-view' is for the browser build's lazy import() only — CanvasKit has to finish loading before anything Skia-backed is even imported.
